contract: One synchronous Unit delivery with validated Envelope and Wiring, consumer-owned codecs and fixed neutral DeliveryResult translation.
limits: Volatile, unbounded mailbox; no ack, retry, redelivery, durability, ordering, deadline enforcement or exactly-once guarantee.
Timeout is an observed exit reason, not proof of elapsed time; noproc leaves dispatch unknown.
Trusted codecs and lookup callbacks; unchanged upstream OTP crash reports may log request/state under consumer Logger configuration.

grounding.claim: Named outcome rows, identity echo, result validation and per-call wiring/codec scenarios; finite tests, not proofs.
Relies on pinned GenServer.call default timeout and exit translation.
Relies on OTP call aliases dropping late replies; receiver state may already have advanced.

telemetry.contract: No events or own logs emitted.

config.contract: Per-call codec module and validated wiring map selection; fixed default call timeout, no retry or hot reconfiguration protocol.

control.contract: OTP lifecycle only; no business drain or cancellation guarantee.
